music.head:
Rockstar continues the tradition of ground-breaking Midnight Club soundtracks – hand-picking a whopping collection of amped-up music perfect to race and ride to – from both cutting-edge underground artists and established legends.

This time around for Midnight Club Los Angeles, extra attention has been paid to the contemporary sonic landscape of California – artists from up and down the West Coast, and songs that have been getting lots of radio and club burn in L.A. specifically. The end result is a massive, yet carefully cultivated soundtrack that should appeal universally to rock, hip-hop, and electronic music lovers worldwide and deliver a fitting, exhilarating score to complement all the intense in-game street racing action.

Click below for the Soundtrack page to check out a full soundtrack list of all 97 songs, broken down by genre – as well as full credits with links relevant to each song.
